nodes.name: Every Morning
nodes.notes: Runs in the n8n server timezone. Aim for it to land before the team starts calling.

nodes.name: Read Existing List
nodes.notes: Read FIRST so anyone the team has already phoned drops off today's list -- the sheet is the single source of truth for human follow-up state. Fails soft: on the very first run the tab may not exist yet, and an empty read simply means nobody has been contacted. | FIXED 2026-08-18 (found on the first real run): an n8n Postgres node executes ONCE PER INCOMING ITEM. Chained after a node returning 1,390 rows this query ran 1,390 times and produced 139,000 output items, flooding the production database with identical reads. executeOnce pins it to a single run; its output is unaffected because Score & Rank reads it by name with .all().

parameters.query:
-- Conversation transcripts. Lives in the AI serviceserviceprod, so it CANNOT be
-- joined in SQL to the sessions/orders data -- that merge happens in the
-- Score & Rank node. Covers everything routed through /ai/chat; the
-- deterministic partner questions and bare digit presses never reach it.
SELECT
  session_id,
  COUNT(*)                                                              AS turns,
  MIN(created_at)                                                       AS first_at,
  MAX(created_at)                                                       AS last_at,
  LEFT(COALESCE(string_agg(content, ' ~~ ' ORDER BY id)
       FILTER (WHERE role = 'user'), ''), 4000)                         AS user_text,
  (array_agg(content ORDER BY id) FILTER (WHERE role = 'user'))[1]      AS first_user_message
FROM rag.conversation_history
WHERE LEFT(session_id, 3) = 'wa_'
  AND created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '45 days'
GROUP BY session_id;

parameters.query:
-- Everything from the logistics database: bot session state, captured
-- fields, paid-ad attribution, registration and order history.
-- Phone matching normalises BOTH sides to the last 9 digits -- verified
-- against real data 2026-08-14 (we store 10000000000, auth_user stores
-- 0700000000 / +233 54 968 8677, sometimes two numbers split by "/").
WITH u AS (
  SELECT a.id, regexp_replace(part, '[^0-9]', '', 'g') AS digits
  FROM auth_user a,
       LATERAL unnest(string_to_array(COALESCE(a.phone_number, ''), '/')) AS part
  WHERE a.phone_number IS NOT NULL AND a.phone_number <> ''
),
un AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT id, RIGHT(digits, 9) AS tail9
  FROM u WHERE LENGTH(digits) >= 9
),
ord AS (
  SELECT un.tail9, COUNT(*) AS order_count, MAX(o.created_on) AS last_order
  FROM un
  JOIN orders o ON o.user_id = un.id AND NOT COALESCE(o.deleted, false)
  GROUP BY un.tail9
)
SELECT
  s.phone,
  s.current_state,
  s.current_context,
  s.created_at   AS first_seen,
  s.updated_at   AS last_activity,
  EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM un WHERE un.tail9 = RIGHT(s.phone, 9))                     AS is_registered,
  COALESCE((SELECT o2.order_count FROM ord o2 WHERE o2.tail9 = RIGHT(s.phone, 9)), 0) AS order_count,
  ls.conversion_source,
  ls.source_app,
  ls.source_id,
  ls.ad_title
FROM app_bot_sessions s
LEFT JOIN app_lead_source ls ON ls.phone = s.phone
WHERE LENGTH(s.phone) BETWEEN 8 AND 15;

nodes.name: Write Priority List
nodes.notes: The human columns (call_status, called_by, call_date, outcome, objection, notes) are deliberately NOT mapped, so a re-run refreshes the bot's columns and never overwrites what the sales team typed. Left on the default error behaviour so a failed write is loud rather than silently producing an empty call list.
